Agarn's vote will decide an election, and O'Rourke schemes to make it pay off handsomely.

O'Rourke's devilish father arrives from Ireland while the sergeant is on vacation.

title: Wild West Chronicles
description:
S01 E12 — Annie Oakley: Rise of a Shooting Star
When a young Annie Oakley accepts a challenge to face one of the best sharpshooters in the country, she wins the match and his heart. Annie Oakley marries trick-shot artist Frank Butler, and they struggle to make it in show business.

title: Wild West Chronicles
description:
S01 E15 — Charles M. Russell: The Cowboy Artist
Charlie Russell is an aimless cowhand who enjoys painting scenes of his life on the range until his new bride, Nancy, gives him the push he needs to stop cowboying in order to focus on the artwork that will soon make him famous.

title: Into the Wild Frontier
description:
S04 E04 — Lucien Maxwell: Legend of New Mexico
Having explored the frontier with his good friend Kit Carson, Lucien Maxwell must survive a deadly clash with the Jicarilla Apache before he can settle down with his family and establish a ranching empire in New Mexico.

title: The Cowboy Way: Alabama
description:
S04 E10 — The Three Wise Cattlemen
Winter brings the holidays, but it also brings the calving season; Bubba, Cody and Booger must monitor their herd around the clock; when a heifer in labor disappears, the cowboys nearly miss their annual holiday party.

After Marshal Ed Masterson is shot while breaking up a barroom brawl, he hastily bans all firearms in Dodge City; Ed's swift proclamation is met with disdain by most townsfolk, including his own brothers, and places an even larger target on his back.

description:
